headline: Biogen (BIIB) Is Up 5.8% After Earnings Compression Amid Revenue Growth – Is Profitability Peaking?
summary: Biogen Inc. has released its second-quarter 2026 results, reporting revenue of US$2.74 billion versus US$2.65 billion a year earlier, while net income dropped to US$97.5 million and diluted EPS from continuing operations fell to US$0.66 from US$4.33. Despite modest revenue growth for both the quarter and first half of 2026, Biogen’s profitability compressed sharply, with six‑month net income falling to US$417.0 million from US$875.3 million, highlighting a widening gap between sales...
